extracted.name: Salmon Cheese Ball
extracted.description: Walnuts and parsley form the outer layer to this beautiful and addicting salmon and cream cheese ball. Horseradish livens up the mixture.
ingredient_lines: 1 (7 ounce) can salmon, drained and flaked
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix salmon, cream cheese, lemon juice, green onions, horseradish, salt, hot pepper sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Form the mixture into a ball and wrap in plastic. Chill in the refrigerator 3 hours, or until firm.
On a large piece of wax paper, mix walnuts and fresh parsley. Roll the ball in the walnuts and parsley until thoroughly coated. Chill in the refrigerator until serving.
